notes.content: This is the continuation page of a typed English letter. In body lines 1–6, the writer apologises for requests for further explanation and describes his assistance with the exposé as limited, asking for a reply only if his questions expose a misconception of the new set-up. In lines 6–9 he plans a preliminary manuscript, a visit to Bures on June 2, and completion of a definite version during that stay. The final e of definite is a blue handwritten insertion. Two typed closing lines precede a blue signature best read J.P. Murre with retained doubt. The lower half is blank except for the archive numeral. No deletion, display, drawing, diagram, letterhead or stamp was observed. Source-view count: 3 (whole once, half_a once, half_b once). Evidence-crop count: 2, each viewed once. The first machine timestamp was recorded just after the initial whole view. The attribution of the blue correction to the signatory is not independently established.
